state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I did not get the robot next to the red ball, so I've stopped it and put it into rest mode as a safe stop.

- **Where it went:** I searched several areas of the room. Most of the red I saw was chair seats. I did briefly see the ball on the floor near a black computer tower and a desk, and I walked toward it. Once I got close, it dropped out of view, probably hidden behind the office chair or desk.
- **Where it is now:** The robot is resting near that desk and chair, about 1.5 m from where it last saw the ball. It is not facing the ball, and I don't know exactly where the ball is.
- **Battery:** About 45% and not charging.

To finish the task, the robot needs someone to point out where the ball is, or to check the area near the computer tower and chairs. Then I can wake the robot and go to it.
